The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. was filed seeking quashing of the entire
criminal proceedings of Complaint No. 2712 of 2018 (Smt. Gulshan Vs. Afeesar and others), under
Sections 498A, 323, 354A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly, pending

3.  Vide order dated 28.02.2023, this Court has passed the following order:
"Learned counsel for the applicants is present.
He has submitted that the parties have arrived at a compromise.
The photocopy of the compromise deed is appended at page-23 of the paper book.

He has further submitted that as the dispute is Afeesar Ali And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114788540/
1 matrimonial and some of the sections involved are non compoundable, hence, the prayer is made to issue a direction to the trial court to verify their compromise deed.

sentences.text: As the dispute is matrimonial and the compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely, therefore, the parties are directed to appear before the trial court within 20 days from today alongwith their compromise deed.

If the parties appear before the trial court within the time stipulated above, the trial court shall verify the said compromise deed, pass verification order thereon and transmit the certified copy of the verified compromise deed alongwith the certified copy of the verification order passed thereon, to this Court within 15 days thereafter.
List on 07th April, 2023.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in Complaint No.2712 of 2018, Smt. Gulshan Vs. Afeesar and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 354A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly,

District Bareilly."
4.

sentences.text: In pursuance of the said order, the report dated 20.03.2023 has been received from the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bareilly, verifying the compromise between the parties on the basis of the statements of the opposite party no.2 and the applicant no.1, herein.

5. Since it was a matrimonial dispute between the applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 and the same has been settled amicably between the parties and settlement has already been verified by the Trial Court.

6. In view thereof, the instant application is allowed and the proceedings of the said Complaint No.2712 of 2018 (Smt. Gulshan Vs. Afeesar and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 354A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Bareilly, District Bareilly, are hereby quashed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
As the dispute is matrimonial and the compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely, therefore, the parties are directed to appear before the trial court within 20 days from today alongwith their compromise deed.
If the parties appear before the trial court within the time stipulated above, the trial court shall verify the said compromise deed, pass verification order thereon and transmit the certified copy of the verified compromise deed alongwith the certified copy of the verification order passed thereon, to this Court within 15 days thereafter.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in Complaint No.2712 of 2018, Smt. Gulshan Vs. Afeesar and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 354A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly,
pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Bareilly,
District Bareilly."
4.
In pursuance of the said order, the report dated 20.03.2023 has been received from the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bareilly, verifying the compromise between the parties on the basis of the statements of the opposite party no.2 and the applicant no.1, herein.
5. Since it was a matrimonial dispute between the applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 and the same has been settled amicably between the parties and settlement has already been verified by the Trial Court.
6. In view thereof, the instant application is allowed and the proceedings of the said Complaint No.2712 of 2018 (Smt. Gulshan Vs. Afeesar and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 354A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Bareilly, District Bareilly, are hereby quashed.
